description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje objekt shume te mirmbajtur ne zone e Astirit tek 2 Palmat. Apartamenti eshte i sapo rinovuar dhe gati per banim.
Me nje orjentim Jug - Perendim e ben Apartamentin me nje ndricim natyral shume te domosdoshem.
description_en: The apartment is located in a very well-maintained building in the area of ​​Astir at 2 Palmat. The apartment is newly renovated and ready for living. With a South-West orientation, the apartment has a very necessary natural light.
